notes: Headroom uses at most 70% of the relevant frame interval; Tight uses up to 100%. These are offline capacity hints, not an in-game FPS or latency guarantee.

MetalFX timings are GPU command intervals on a decoded video still. VideoToolbox timings are processor completion wall time over consecutive real video frames resized before timing where needed; its internal GPU time is not exposed.
MLX-DLSS is not an XFrame rendering backend and its proprietary weights are not bundled, so it is not assigned a built-in grade.
